Markets.title: South Korea prepares market stabilisation funds after KOSPI hits 10-month low
Markets.summary: South Korea's finance ministry is preparing to activate market stabilization funds after the KOSPI stock index hit a 10-month low. The finance minister convened an emergency meeting to discuss strategies for restoring investor confidence, including temporary regulations on stock buyback limits for public companies.

Markets.title: Crude oil futures brace for OPEC+ output decision amid supply glut concerns: Analysts
Markets.summary: Crude oil futures are bracing for volatility ahead of the upcoming OPEC+ meeting and inventory reports from the API and EIA amid a growing global supply surplus.
